provenance.availabilityPolicy: Explicit available_at when provided; otherwise conservative game-date+2days assumption, not verified publication time.
provenance.reliability: historical_source_supplied; source revisions and quote timestamps not independently verified

marketComparison.sourceMeaning: Indicative source historical home/away moneylines normalized to remove two-sided overround. Moneyline tie/push terms and quote times are unverified; not exact DK Predictions binary settlement or executable prices.

reasons: Historical source availability/revisions and market quote timing are not independently verified.
Validation is for home-win game outcomes only; does not validate player props or fitted play-by-play distributions.
No automated production promotion; report prospective monitoring and complete uncertainty first.

validation: Nested chronological tuning, separate early/late calibration-year partitions for Platt and stacking, rolling annual untouched holdouts; no market features in independent models.
predictionTarget: Home win YES; ties are NO. No claim about away-win conditional probability.
limitations: No injury, roster, player, weather or play-by-play features are inferred from absent sources.
Recency half-lives and shrinkage priors are declared modeling choices; model parameters and tuning choices are data-fitted.
Laplace uncertainty conditions on the model family and fitted hyperparameter; not all structural uncertainty.
Week-block bootstrap addresses some within-week dependence, not all nonstationarity.

featureDrift.method: Training-quantile population stability index with half-count smoothing.0.25 is a declared diagnostic heuristic, not proof of predictive drift.

bayesian.scope: Descriptive paired holdout comparison; no assumption an ensemble improves every component.

regularized.scope: Descriptive paired holdout comparison; no assumption an ensemble improves every component.

boosting.scope: Descriptive paired holdout comparison; no assumption an ensemble improves every component.
